Which segment has the highest expected revenue per customer (expected_revenue / customers)? Return all segments tied at the highest value.
analyst.sql:
WITH __segments AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    segment_name,
    customers,
    expected_revenue
  FROM customer_segmentation.analyst.segments
), rev_per_cust AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    segment_name,
    expected_revenue,
    customers,
    expected_revenue / NULLIF(NULLIF(customers, 0), 0) AS revenue_per_customer
  FROM __segments
)
SELECT
  segment,
  segment_name,
  expected_revenue,
  customers,
  revenue_per_customer
FROM rev_per_cust
QUALIFY
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_per_customer DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
